name: lcmodel-bruker-preproc
author: Stephen Provencher / Denis Grenier / Théotime Ferh--Delude
description: MR spectrosocpy signal quantification software. More details available on https://s-provencher.com/lcmodel.shtml
command-line: unzip -j [ZIP_BASIS] -d basis && python3 /bruker-spectro-processing-pipeline/vip_prepro.py [FIDFILE] [ACQPFILE] [METHODFILE] [REFSCANFILE] [RAWJOB0FILE] [PPM_R] [PPM_A] [NOISE_R] [DISPLAY_R] [MEAN_LW] [STDEV_LW] [STDEV_FR] [MV_AV] --outname [OUTNAME] --outpath ./ && echo "Preprocessing finished, listing files and launching LCModel" && ls && bash /run_lcmodel.sh [CTRL_FILE] [PASTIS_RAW] basis [OUTNAME]_pastis_lcmodel && bash /run_lcmodel.sh [CTRL_FILE] [BRUKER_RAW] basis [OUTNAME]_bruker_lcmodel && tar -czvf [OUTNAME]_pastis_lcmodel.tar.gz [OUTNAME]_pastis_lcmodel_* && tar -czvf [OUTNAME]_bruker_lcmodel.tar.gz [OUTNAME]_bruker_lcmodel_* && rm -rf basis

inputs.name: Control file
inputs.description: Text file with extension '.control' setting up constraints, options and prior knowledge used in LCModel algorithm

inputs.name: Zipped data base folder
inputs.description: Archive containing all metabolite & macromolecules in .RAW format

inputs.name: ppm_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format start_end   . frequency region in ppm on which phasing operations are focused.

inputs.name: ppm_a
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format start_end   . frequency region in ppm on which SNR and LW analysis are performed (NAA peak).

inputs.name: noise_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format start_end   . frequency region in ppm on which noise level is estimated

inputs.name: display_r
inputs.description: MUST be an interval in the format start_end   . frequency region in ppm used to display the spectra

inputs.name: mean_lw_Hz
inputs.description: Mean linewidth considered as good linewidth for further analysis (Hz)

inputs.name: stdev_lw_Hz
inputs.description: acceptable standard deviation around the mean linewidth (Hz)

inputs.name: stdev_fr_ppm
inputs.description: acceptable standard deviation/amplitude of the frequency fluctuation/drift in ppm

inputs.name: mv_av
inputs.description: number of spectra in a moving average used in the analyze and reject procedure
